company.name: Bahri
company.shortDescription: Bahri is a transportation and logistics company that provides shipping services.
company.description: Bahri is a transportation and logistics company that operates around five business units that include oil, chemicals, logistics, dry bulk, marine, and ship management. Their service offering includes transportation of crude oil, oil products, chemicals, bulk, and general cargo, as well as ship management.
